mappingPolicy: Committed entry fields are regenerated from the clean source tree. Dirty-only rows retain their reviewed source identity and hash in mobile/frameleaf-preserved-dirty-evidence.json; original implementation or nativeEvidence fields describe only that uncommitted checkout and are superseded by sourceAvailability and qualification. Primary stories own native behavior or identity integration; secondary stories own interacting workflows and qualification.
scope: Every committed native source-inventory entry plus the 16 hashed dirty-only preservation requirements. Ownership is not committed implementation, runtime availability, authorization, or device qualification.
